name: @gcu/bz2
description: bzip2 in plain JavaScript, both directions: a line-for-line port of libbzip2 1.0.8, so the streams it writes are byte-identical to bzip2's (and CPython's bz2) and it reads them as libbzip2 does — streamed, with maxLength, needsInput and unusedData. No Wasm, no dependencies.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia (port); Julian Seward (bzip2/libbzip2)
